name: changedetection-io
description: Watch web pages for changes, price drops and restocks, and get alerts.

paths.name: Datastore
paths.description: Your watches, their history, snapshots and settings. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: changedetection.io web page and API, published on host as 6734

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: The address put in notification links. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6734. The app works without it; only the links in alerts need it.
